card.name: Words just before animals or insects
card.fires_on: Verbs, linking words and endings that come right before a noun for animals, insects or pests, such as insects, flies, ticks, mosquitoes or fish. It fires on the word before the creature noun, in nature and garden text.

modes.label: Verb before creatures
modes.description: An action word such as kill, eat, bred or picking off, where creatures are the likely next word.
modes.example: Establish and document that the animals can readily kill and<< eat>> live fish

modes.label: Modifier before insects
modes.description: A describing word or ending such as beneficial or -ing right before insects or ticks.
modes.example: provide habitats for birds, butterflies and<< beneficial>> insects

modes.label: Linking word in creature lists
modes.description: A word like of or and that leads into a named group of animals or pests.
modes.example: it would attract a lot<< of>> flies and bacteria

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict creature words such as creatures, animals, insects and wildlife next.
card.plain: It lights up on the word just before an animal or insect word is expected.
